title: Injective monoid maps induce injective monoid-algebra maps
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $M,N$ be commutative additive monoids, and let $u:M\to N$ be an injective additive monoid homomorphism. Write $R[M]=\bigoplus_{m\in M}Re^m$ with $e^me^{m\prime}=e^{m+m\prime}$, and similarly for $R[N]$. Then the $R$-linear monomial map $u_*:R[M]\to R[N]$, $e^m\mapsto e^{u(m)}$, is an injective unital ring homomorphism. Additive monoid conventions are those of [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup].
